children: (NYSE American: LGPS) (the “Company” or “LogProstyle”), headquartered in Minato-ku, Tokyo, Japan, announced today that members of its senior management team will participate in investor conferences in New York and the Vancouver metropolitan area during September 2026.

The Company develops residential real estate in the greater Tokyo metropolitan area and operates hospitality businesses that provide distinctive Japanese lodging experiences. Through participation in these conferences, management intends to discuss the Company’s business model, growth strategy, capital allocation approach, inbound tourism opportunities, and long-term expansion plans, including potential M&A.
1. Moody Capital Solutions 2026 Disruptive Growth & Life Sciences Conference

Yasuyuki Nozawa, Representative Director, President and CEO, will participate in the two-day conference in New York, where he will deliver an investor presentation and hold one-on-one meetings. He will discuss the Company’s established business foundation, competitive strengths, and future growth opportunities.
The Westin New York Grand Central (212 E 42nd St, New York, NY 10017)
Yasuyuki Nozawa (Representative Director, President and CEO)

Keien Natsume, Executive Officer and Head of Corporate Strategy, will speak as both a Corporate Speaker and Workshop Speaker. Before joining the Company to oversee corporate strategy, M&A, and investor relations, Ms. Natsume spent many years launching and operating businesses in the hotel, restaurant, and retail sectors — including multi-store operations and franchise development — across Japan, mainland China, Hong Kong, Macau, and other Asian markets. Drawing on this international perspective, she will share the Company's business strategy and growth potential and engage in dialogue with investors and industry participants.
Executive Hotel Vancouver Airport (7311 Westminster Highway, Richmond, BC, Canada)
Keien Natsume (Executive Officer, Head of Corporate Strategy)

LogProstyle Inc. operates businesses in residential real estate development, hotel management, and restaurant management. With the slogan "redefine life style," the Company is working on various projects with the aim of illustrating an innovative and sustainable lifestyle. LogProstyle is the first unlisted Japanese company to list its Japanese common shares directly on a major United States stock exchange rather than through American Depositary Receipts (ADRs).
